kept.description: Fields whose latest bot suggestion still matches the current OSIDB value
kept.title: Kept

modified.description: Fields whose latest bot suggestion differs from the current OSIDB value
modified.title: Modified

skipped.description: Flaw fields the bot skipped on quality gates (type=AI-Bot-Skipped), counted once per field even if it was re-skipped (only possible via `osidb-bot --force`).

suggested.description: Flaw fields the bot made a suggestion for (type=AI-Bot), counted once per field even if it was re-suggested (only possible via `osidb-bot --force`). Because kept and modified reflect one accept-or-modify decision per field (the latest suggestion only), suggested is >= kept + modified -- a checkable data-integrity bound.

BotKPIEntry.description:
A compact bot record, included with detail=true.

For each CVE/feature, count suggestions and skips once and compare only the
latest in-window suggestion. Deviation is against the current flaw value,
not a historical snapshot. Null deviation means the record was not scored.
BotKPIEntry.title: BotKPIEntry

BotKPIResponse.description:
Response model for osidb-bot KPI metrics endpoint.

Every response is a page of a stable delivery run and carries
authoritative cumulative aggregates over the delivered population.
``delivery`` counts selected flaws received, including those emitting no
detail records. ``entries`` remains page-local. After index discovery
completes, membership and accepted observations are stable for the run;
they are not an atomic historical OSIDB snapshot.

available_components.description: Sorted unique affected components in the delivered bot flaws, only with detail=true; cumulative on every page
available_components.title: Available Components

delivery.description: Delivery run identity, continuation, and received population. Aggregates are cumulative on every page; entries describe only this page.

entries.description: Compact suggestion/skip records for this page's flaws, only with detail=true
entries.title: Entries

features.description: Per-feature KPI metrics keyed by field name. Cumulative over the delivered population.
features.title: Features

total_flaws_processed.description: Number of bot-processed flaws that contributed to the result: those with at least one suggestion whose timestamp falls in the selected time range, or all bot-processed flaws when no range is given. Cumulative over the delivered population.
total_flaws_processed.title: Total Flaws Processed

BotKPIResponse.title: BotKPIResponse

get.description: Retrieve KPI metrics for flaws auto-processed by the osidb-bot. Compares bot suggestions against current flaw values to measure how often analysts keep, modify, or skip bot suggestions. Only flaws in DONE workflow state are included. Results are cached and incrementally updated on subsequent requests; a flaw is automatically re-scored whenever it changes in OSIDB. Responses are served through stable delivery runs: the first request establishes a run and reports zero received flaws; each follow-up refreshes one page-sized slice of the OSIDB cache (also bounded by the request's refresh budget, max_refresh_secs, defaulting to AEGIS_BOT_KPI_MAX_REFRESH_SECS) and returns that slice's detail entries plus cumulative aggregates, continuing through delivery.continue_token until it is absent. Budget deferrals return 200 with deferred=true and a held continue_token. Run membership freezes after index discovery; values are observed during fetching, not an atomic historical OSIDB snapshot.

Receive feedback and log it to CSV file.

All data is preserved without modification. CSV library handles escaping.

Receive programmatic feedback and log it to CSV file.

This endpoint captures AI suggestion acceptance data when users save flaws,
including the suggested value and submitted value. The acceptance score is
calculated server-side based on whether the values match. For features that
support semantic similarity (title, description, statement, mitigation),
semantic proximity scoring is attempted. If semantic scoring fails or times out,
the entry remains with an empty acceptance_score and can be retried later.
